tool_arguments.prompt: Create ONE fresh standalone transparent PNG of the exact adopted zebra garden eel character in the direct reference, same watercolor paper texture inside the body, broad alternating chocolate brown and cream bands, thin warm brown contour, tiny solid brown dot eye, rounded smiling face, no clothes or objects. Entire continuous S-shaped long body and tapered tail must fit with generous clear margin. Large native art, not a grid. This is the cheer role. A cheerful pleased expression and gentle upward head tilt; no jump, no props, no extra fin gestures. ANATOMY STRICT: copy the adopted reference visible anatomy: exactly ONE small fan-shaped near-side fin under the cheek and ONE small far-side fin behind the neck. These are the ONLY TWO fin projections. Do not add another fan fin under the head; do not keep both old resting and raised versions. Do not add dorsal fins, hands, arms, feet, fingers, eyebrows, sparkles, shadows, background haze or ground. Expression/head angle gives the gesture, fins stay in the original resting positions. Preserve original body length, breadth, spacing of bands, tiny dot eye and simple style. Empty canvas is true alpha zero, no translucent backdrop or outer glow. The reference supplies identity, style, anatomy and scale; redraw from scratch, not pixel edit.
